Windows x64: Fix updater to select the exact published Windows Setup EXE, verify its SHA256 before installation, distinguish newest published release from unshipped source, and recheck on app resume. Windows releases remain draft until source revision and asset sizes pass verification. Includes Flat, Dialogue, Cinema and Warm, new Discovery filters, Details source counts and current shared player fixes. Preserves existing playback, subtitles, Night Mode, TorBox, settings and media libraries.
